original_card.question: Is there a genuinely unsearched, explicitly bounded improvement to the selected packing?
methods: Search a named unclaimed canonical candidate domain with a reproducible partition.
Prove a stronger scoped relaxation or exact optimum for one named residual subproblem.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Check live PR overlap first, price both suppliers and distinguish a search best from an optimum. Report the word's packing cap from ceiling.ceiling() and the fraction of it realized; label packing gains as such.

first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Define an unclaimed canonical domain and a favorable bound before starting a new search.
original_card.bottleneck_link: An actual paid-profile gain can improve the frontier up to the other supplier cap.
allowed_variations: One bounded residual packing instance or exact relaxation.
If the coverage law, template or guard changes, derive an applicable fully charged replacement bound instead of applying the incumbent ceiling outside its scope.

existing_checks.scope: Packing-independent ceiling for the selected paid profile under the one-unpaid-coordinate coverage and halving guard.
existing_checks.remaining: A changed word or model requires new pricing; a local packing search must name uncovered scope.

actual_scope: A joint rank-only CP-SAT search over the pinned PR #3200 T740 idle-axis domain, followed by source-bound exact eight-stream operator replays of its best frozen candidate and the newer PR #3251 per-group candidate.
scope_change_reason: The donor explicitly assigned the goal of improving the best available kappa and asked to continue with OR-Tools. A rank-only model found a better hypothetical profile than PR #3200, but exact replay rejects it. A fresh overlap refresh then found PR #3251's still-higher per-group headline; its pinned candidate also fails exact replay in owner replica 0 / port 0. Cached related work includes PR #3199's four-idle-child exact-coordinate CP-SAT screen, PR #3204's broader four-site rigidity result, and PR #3220's additive repair-cost bound. This package contributes two candidate-specific physical counterexamples, not a new supplier or kappa.
bottleneck_link: Both saved numerical profiles pass rank, commute and moment checks, but their exact physical operators change in a T740 group. Operator equality must enter the optimization or act as an exact post-search filter before a numerical profile can count as a kappa improvement.
stop_rule: Stop after replaying the saved global rank-only candidate and the current higher PR #3251 per-group candidate against the exact operator. Do not continue rank-only seed or runtime searches; require exact operator constraints or a certified exact filter before further moment optimization.
evidence: RANK-ONLY-MOVES.json.gz and RANK-ONLY-RESULT.json retain the OR-Tools FEASIBLE candidate and hypothetical moment/root. The package also pins the PR #3251 BINS/MOVES/RESULT artifacts to exact head d7d6254416f0b3ffe659079cca42fd152df63a36. The inherited PR #3200 verifier accepts that conditional profile, while the merged source-bound eight-stream replay reproduces matrix mismatches at 2^53 for the OR-Tools candidate and 2^52 for the higher PR #3251 candidate, both at owner replica 0 / port 0. A fresh overlap snapshot at 2026-10-17 19:46 UTC covered 309 open PRs and 2,095 discussions without warnings. No new admissible kappa is claimed; the selected record is unchanged. A repeat of the parallel CP-SAT run returned only the baseline rank profile, so incumbent discovery is nondeterministic.

open_questions.question: Can exchanges involving partially hosted donors preserve the exact eight-stream operator while changing net ranks?
open_questions.why_it_matters: This counterexample rejects the best rank-only incumbent, but does not prove all exchange patterns invalid; a valid operator-preserving profile change could still raise a supplier endpoint.
open_questions.first_step: Derive exact per-character constraints for one representative eight-child T740 port pattern, including children 8, 10, 12, 14 and 15, then screen all rank-changing assignments in that bounded group.
open_questions.blocked_by: The current optimization encodes rank, source-axis uniqueness, orthogonality, translations and role constraints, but not the coupled physical operator equality.

open_questions.question: Can the global optimizer include exact operator constraints without exceeding practical memory and runtime?
